name: Nozawa Shouko
source: She is a classmate of Shishihachi and the others, in the class next to them, and a member of the Literature Club. She is a high school girl writer who has already won several awards and is known only to those in the know, but she is a very casual, ordinary girl who is affectionately nicknamed Nocchan. Recently, the club president, Nagase Kentaro, has been trying to create suspicious doujinshi whenever he gets the chance, and it seems like she is having a hard time trying to stop him.
